mentions.name: ThreadWise
mentions.description: Email-based AI assistant service that lets users send prompts to a personal ThreadWise address and receive instant AI-powered responses, like an always-available co-worker. Supports scheduling recurring tasks such as daily mortgage rates, airfare price monitoring, weather and news summaries, sports scores, and pulling data from public APIs, effectively serving as a personalized newsletter. Offers a free tier and can run on public LLMs (e.g. OpenAI) or on-premise locally hosted models so company data never leaves the premises.
mentions.problem: People want quick access to AI in instances where they cannot always install apps or use browser-based tools, such as remote or low bandwidth environments; companies without bandwidth to set up full-fledged AI solutions lack an easy path to AI access.
mentions.audience: People wanting quick AI access in remote or low-bandwidth environments where they cannot install apps or use browsers, and companies that lack the bandwidth to set up full AI solutions on their own.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I am building a service to make accessing AI as easy as sending email called ThreadWise

https://threadwise.app

You can email prompts directly to your ThreadWise address and get instant AI-powered responses, essentially an always available co-worker.
